d: A woman visits her Aunt in England for the holidays where she meets a handsome historian who is determined to promote her Aunt manor as a historical landmark. Starring Deirdre Mullins (2020)
(2021) Moving romance starring Torrey DeVitto, Dylan Bruce and Patrick Duffy. Heartbroken after losing her fiancé, can Nicole find a way to rebuild her life and take a second chance on love?
2021) Festive romcom starring Emily Osment. It may be Christmas Eve and her brother's wedding too, but can Leah's childhood crush give our overshadowed bridesmaid a 30th birthday to remember?
(2020) Christmas romance with Cindy Sampson. To save her school from closure, a principal asks a Hollywood star - and former flame - to direct the school play. Will it set the stage for love?
